item.g:title: Borussia Dortmund 2017/18 Home Shirt — Marco Reus, Match Worn / Issued
item.g:description: Match Worn / Issued version of Dortmund's 2017/18 home shirt. The differences with the fan shop shirts are in the build: PUMA's PWR ACTV athletic taping runs strategically through the body for freedom of movement on the pitch, the club crest and PUMA cat are applied in lightweight transfer material rather than the printed or stitched patches used on replica shirts, and there is no black "Authentic" patch on the lower front, since that detail is only added to retail versions. The style code on the wash label was never sold commercially, so it cannot be matched to anything in PUMA's public catalogue. Name, number and the "Dortmund" lettering on the lower back are rubberized rather than pixel-printed, and the collar carries the rubberized BVB lettering used across the squad's kit that year. Evonik features as chest sponsor, as it did throughout that Bundesliga season.

item.g:title: Borussia Dortmund 2016/17 Home Shirt — Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, Match Worn / Issued
item.g:description: Match Worn / Issued Dortmund 2016/17 home shir Pierre - Emerick Aubameyang. Where a retail shirt is cut for a relaxed, one-size-fits-all fit, this one carries PUMA's player-issue construction: a closer, more athletic cut with added stretch through the body, the club crest and PUMA cat applied in lightweight transfer material instead of the patches used on replica shirts, and no black "Authentic" patch on the lower front, a detail only found on retail versions. The style code on the wash label was never available to buy in shops. Name, number and the "Dortmund" lettering on the lower back are rubberized rather than printed, and the collar carries the rubberized BVB lettering used across that season's kit. Evonik features as chest sponsor, in the black block-stripe design PUMA introduced that year.

item.g:title: Fiorentina 1992 "Banned" Home Shirt — Rare Vintage Original, Size L
item.g:description: Original Fiorentina home shirt from 1992, one of the most talked-about kits in football history. This is the shirt that was withdrawn from sale after the repeating pattern in the design was said to resemble a swastika when viewed at certain angles. Fiorentina pulled it, and what was left became one of the most collectable Serie A shirts ever produced. Very few genuine examples circulate. Please note: the number on this shirt was applied later, not at the time of production. Size L. Condition: very good.

item.g:title: AC Milan 1990/91 Home Shirt — Vintage Original, Size XL
item.g:description: Original AC Milan home shirt from the 1990/91 season, in the club's unmistakable red and black stripes. This is the shirt of one of the greatest club sides ever assembled. In the seasons around this kit, Milan swept through Europe under Arrigo Sacchi and Fabio Capello, with Marco van Basten, Ruud Gullit and Frank Rijkaard in attack and Franco Baresi and Paolo Maldini behind them. Few shirts carry this much weight in club football history. Size XL. Condition: very good, with normal signs of age for a shirt of this era. An original from the period, not a reissue or reproduction.
